# 5. Architecture models

The models follow the C4 levels: the system in its context (level 1), the containers it runs in (level 2) and the components inside each container (level 3), with the deployment that runs them. Each figure is drawn from the saved records by the same model and renderer as the pictures on screen; positions are a projection, never facts.

## Context diagram (Level 1)

Purpose: The system, the people who take part in its journey and the external systems it exchanges with.

None recorded: no application component is recorded yet; the context has no system to draw.

## Container diagram (Level 2)

Purpose: The containers the system runs in, each with the components it holds, the stores they keep data in, the external systems they exchange with, and the contracts between them.

None recorded: no application component is recorded yet, so there is no container to draw.

## Component diagrams (Level 3)

Purpose: The components inside one container, the interactions and contracts between them, and the containers and external systems they reach.

None recorded: no container holds an application component (Chapter 5 · Work).

## Deployment diagram

Purpose: Per environment: trust boundaries, zones, the placements in them, what each stands on and the numbered runtime paths.

None recorded: nothing is placed in an environment yet; no environment is recorded.

## D. Annexes

The registers are separate exports, never printed in this document’s body. Each is read from the same saved records.

| Annex | What it holds | How to export it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Requirement register, by group | Every requirement with its external id, statement, priority and source assertions, group by group, a page at a time | /api/export?chapter=11&annex=requirements&format=md&page=1 (also csv, json) |
| Traceability matrix | Every requirement against each layer of the design, the curated links apart from the trails derived from them | /api/export?chapter=11&annex=matrix&format=csv |
| Change journal | Every recorded change with its fields before and after and its affected records, a page at a time | /api/export?chapter=11&document=changes&format=md&page=1 (also csv, json; a hundred changes a page) |
| Architecture requirements specification | Each quality driver as a requirement with its scenario, target, verification and trace; constraints and assumptions | /api/export?chapter=2&document=ars&format=md |
| Component specifications | One specification per component: responsibilities, interfaces, data, requirements, quality, technology, protection and runtime | /api/export?chapter=11&annex=specifications&format=md (one: chapter=5&document=spec&id=) |
| Interface specifications | The contracts as OpenAPI and AsyncAPI documents | /api/export?chapter=8&format=openapi (and format=asyncapi) |
| Figures | Every figure of section 5: each level’s overview with the detail of every group it folds, and the component diagram of every container, each fitting one page | /api/export?chapter=11&annex=figures&format=html (also pdf, and zip for the SVG files with their manifest) |
| Chapter registers | Every record of each chapter with every field | /api/export?chapter=1&format=md (chapters 1 to 10) |
| Review registers | The review records: findings and treatments, delivery obligations, change review, performance and reasoning records | /api/export?chapter=11&annex=registers&format=md |
